changeLog.change: User supersedes routine metered/order-level loading and driver return declaration with one daily weighed run, before/after customer cylinder readings and office closing reconciliation. Historical data and unrelated holds retained; no existing trips silently converted.

Daily supplied gas now appears in Dispatch totals at measurement time, before pending photo completion. Carry-forward excludes same-visit/mixed physical returns. Existing native source fixes were preserved as prerequisites; no signed binary publication claim.

Daily office modal waits for actual driver departure, scale supply and current photo instead of offering an unusable pickup action. Live day counters refresh without remounting entered weight forms. Earlier setup/trip controls are collapsed; legacy checks remain. Departure audit describes the actual daily-allocation action.
